items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Manuel Perez used to use him and Eddie Sherry. Yeah.

ctx.x: No. Well, Manuel Perez used to use saxophone when I was playing with Manuel Perez and Roofgaard. Yeah. I mean, on the street, though, in the grass bands.
Yeah, Manuel Perez used to use him and Eddie Sherry. Yeah.

Manuel used to use 12 pieces. He used to use 12 pieces. But he's big old. He used to play tenor with us sometime in the street. Nice play alto. And how they call him? Horse Manero? You know Manero Manero?
